objective: Define the smallest independently reviewable permission delta that could support the frozen original diagnostic statements, without changing queries, financial/data/source semantics, identity guards, time/resource bounds or accepting FS13.

evidence.facts: Direct mfdata_verified_reader/RR READ ONLY/5s statement5s lock15s transaction. Four schemas USAGE true/CREATE false; all15 relations exist. Table and any-column SELECT false for mf.current_fund_facts and mf.fund_variants; other13 SELECT true. All tested write/elevation flags false/memberships0.
evidence.limitations: Point-in-time current effective permissions, not fresh current owner/grantor/column inventory. Does not identify exact historical denied statement or original K/core-role ReadTimeout cause, plans, performance, active DB projection/configuration/populations or acceptance.

static_baseline.observation: Historical optional reconciler grants selected named base tables but not these two targets, and first revokes table/column ACLs broadly for three verified-review roles. Existing rollout_database.install path invokes it. Absence of the two grants is not by itself proof of a bug. Do NOT run that reconciler to fix this gap or amend its historical bytes/outputs.

security_decision.candidate: Existing-role, two-object, explicit-column SELECT-only profile, conditional on owner approval of shared-role exposure.
security_decision.shared_role_warning: mfdata_verified_reader is not a job-scoped identity. Grants affect every session/consumer using that principal; no claim of only code154117, one-job or one-execution database enforcement. Current targets have row_security=false in retained catalogue. Any newly granted column can be read across all rows exposed by that object. Owner must explicitly accept this boundary before a live change.
security_decision.alternative: If shared-role exposure is unacceptable, STOP this candidate. Prepare a separately authorized dedicated diagnostic-principal design; it would require separately reviewed identity/credential/worker/controller changes and full delivery gates. Never switch to admin/core-role or SET ROLE as a fallback.

candidate_delta.why: Only variant identifiers/group join keys referenced by both frozen sibling statements.

candidate_delta.unresolved: Enumerate and freeze EVERY current non-dropped visible view column in actual ordinal order in a separately approved metadata-only preflight. The unchanged batch statement contains SELECT *; granting only fields referenced after planning is not presumed sufficient. No executable grant can be generated until exact live column names/types/attnums and view definition hash are admitted.
candidate_delta.why: Explicit present-column grants avoid a table/view-wide SELECT privilege that would automatically include future columns. A new view column must cause renewed review, not silent privilege expansion.

excluded: No table-wide SELECT fallback, ALL TABLES/ALL PRIVILEGES/wildcards/default privileges/PUBLIC/grant option.
No schema/database CREATE, DML, sequence/function access, owner changes, role membership/inheritance changes, password rotation, new secret/IAM grants or SET ROLE.
No view definition/security_invoker/security_barrier/RLS policy changes or grant on underlying relations by inference.
No query rewrite, selector/code154117 change, sampling, EXPLAIN ANALYZE/application row query, timeout/resource/stack increase or assertion/audit weakening.
No existing services/jobs/schedules/source registry/policy/migration allocations; no production/NSE/sourceHTTP/ledger query.

approval_and_delivery_gates.required_before: Any access-repair/grant implementation or permission write, NOT metadata-only code preparation
approval_and_delivery_gates.deliverable: Human owner chooses shared-role explicit-column candidate versus separately scoped dedicated identity, lifetime, allowed consumers/all-row exposure and operating grantor/credential. These decisions block permission-repair implementation/write, not independent metadata-only code preparation. Metadata preparation requires reviewed metadata design and scoped human implementation authority; live metadata execution additionally requires exact delivered inputs/readiness approval. This gate-order correction supplies neither authority.

approval_and_delivery_gates.required_before: Executable change bytes or live approval
approval_and_delivery_gates.deliverable: With separate exact read-only authority: fresh object namespace/name/OID/kind/owner; all ordered view columns/attnums/types; full view definition hash/security mode/dependency and function-execution implications; exact direct role/column ACLs with grantors/options; effective table AND each-column privileges including pre-existing grants via PUBLIC/membership; no role elevation/write capability; known grantor authority and existing source/core/private consumer reference inventory without credential values. No application data, query planning/execution, migration-ledger or source requests. New identity/inputs/start authority only if a job is approved; no old diagnostic reuse.

Freeze exact two-object column lists, OIDs/definitions/before ACL hashes, role, grantor, planned additive delta/lifetime, transaction/race guards, explicit rollback delta and verification request inventory. New additive optional versioned profile; allocate no SQL/policy number before actual authorized ledger/conflict process if a repository migration is chosen. Preserve old reconciler; future provisioning/reconciliation composition must be reviewed so old broad reconciliation cannot silently erase/reapply the candidate profile. No automatic profile admission or wildcard expansion.

Isolated worktree/plan-before-code, focused+full tests, unchanged nativePG18/full contracts/security/audit/original BOTH-image smokes, exact-head named review/fix/re-review, normal match-head merge/identical reviewed tree/whole independent main CI. No docs-only deployment; actual runtime tools/images additionally need full exact provenance and immutable profile gates. No localPG/Docker/new cloud clone or existing gate-variable write.

Human approval must name DEV account/project/region/database, exact role/two object OIDs+column lists/plan SHA/grantor/input hashes, lifetime, original one change operation, 5s statement/5s lock/15s transaction bounds and prearmed exact-delta reversal authority. No grant option/identity/DDL/source change or second attempt. No broad owner role or credentials reused from another task.

Only after G1-G5: verified exact live before fingerprints and reviewed stable-identity/ACL administrative-race guard. One transactional additive change, fail on any unknown/concurrent drift; no replay/broad privilege reconciler. Retain original PID/session/EXIT and sanitized exact SQL/request bytes plus before/after ACL/capability/profile evidence. Verify every required column true, unrelated direct/effective ACLs exactly unchanged, no grant option/DML/DDL/function/sequence/elevation/membership/credential/IAM/schedule/data/view-definition changes. Table-level has_table_privilege may remain false by design; has_any_column_privilege alone is insufficient.

Permission delivery does NOT authorize an app query or consume/restore an old diagnostic. A wholly new identity/root/manifest/one-shot job and separately approved exact original SQL/role/154117/bounds must be reviewed and delivered with whole CI/final images twice/fresh readiness/whole request and immutable deployment seals/full evidence/final inventory THEN protected LAST provider read. Old jobs/STARTs remain immutable. A current reader plan is still not historical core-role/K causality or acceptance.

rollback_and_failure.before_commit: Any mismatch, warning, exception or timeout before commit -> transactional rollback and STOP. No blind retry.
rollback_and_failure.after_commit: Only a separately preapproved reversal of this exact new grant delta; never REVOKE ALL/CASCADE or remove pre-existing/other-operator privileges. Before reversal require exact recorded current direct ACL/grantor state and identity/definition matching. If other ACL changes/dependencies or commit result ambiguity exist, retain all and STOP for owner decision; do not guess, automatically retry, or continue to a diagnostic.
rollback_and_failure.lifetime: Must be explicitly selected at G1/G5; no implied permanent grant and no unreviewed timer/revocation job.
rollback_and_failure.baseline: A deliberate DB ACL delta needs its own approved scoped before/after baseline. Equal cloud protected profiles do not prove DB ACL/data preservation; do not overwrite historical FS13/protected acceptance records.

provider_free: Verify exactly two fixed qualified targets/one fixed grantee/SELECT-column/no grant option; reject wildcards/defaults/role/schema/owner/extra privileges/objects.
Reject unresolved view-column inventory, unexpected column/attnum/type/definition/OID/owner/security mode drift, duplicate or missing columns and unknown grantor/lifetime.
Verify full actual request/env/argv/startup budget before any intent if a cloud controller is proposed; consume once before ambiguous I/O.
Reject inherited/direct/column privileges outside exact delta, unsafe row exposure assumptions, and rollback touching pre-existing grants.
native_CI_fixture_only: Disposable CI PostgreSQL18 fixtures for baseline reader denied SELECT on both targets; grant only two variant columns and frozen present-view columns, then privilege-only checks and separately scoped unchanged EXPLAIN/SELECT test-fixture queries succeed.
Prove an ungranted variant column remains denied; adding a new view column makes frozen SELECT * fail closed until a new column-profile review.
Prove other roles/ACLs, all fixture row values, view definitions, memberships, PUBLIC/default/function/sequence/DML/DDL privileges unchanged.

Test transaction abort/no partial grants, exact-delta reversal preserving pre-existing column grants, concurrent administrative drift/ambiguous commit STOP, and rejected revoke-CASCADE/broad helper replay.
Test approved future provisioning composition only with explicit additive profile; no historical script alteration and no silent admission after old broad reconciliation.

unchanged_future_scope.five_sprints: S1 incomplete -> S2 fresh FS13+extra actual core+reviewed handover -> S3 NSE contracts -> S4 NSE delivery -> S5 EXP01. ALL original16 gates, source/PDF authority, preservation/clone/restore/full cohort/bytes and no-waiver bounds retained; no authority expansion from this plan.

official_semantics_sources.use: Object versus column privileges; no grant option. Whole-object SELECT is not restricted to an individual code/job.
Views may use owner rather than invoker relation privileges; exact view/owner/dependencies must be reviewed, not assumed.
Column access alone is not row scoping; absent relevant row-security policy, the grantee can read every exposed row. No RLS change proposed.
